assets.name: trunk
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one transparent modular trunk-and-bare-branches sprite for a side-view 2D dark-fantasy pixel-art game.
Input image 1 is the existing trunk to redesign, keeping its hand-painted pixel-art material language and open space at the ground for a separate campfire. The present trunk is far too low and wide.
Primary request: create a substantially TALLER ancient living oak sanctuary skeleton, with stout upright root-pillars and an elevated branching crown. Broad exposed roots form two feet and merge into a noble tall branching trunk around a generous open doorway at ground centre. The doorway should remain empty and be at least one third of the tree width, with enough height for a separate large campfire. The tree should occupy most of the image height, not only its lower half.
Composition: a complete single tree frame, flat front/side orthographic view, no perspective floor. Landscape image about 1536 by 1024. Ground/root tips at 94 percent of image height; highest branches near 9 percent. All extremities inside frame with modest clean margin. Clearly readable main branches spread into five open crown fans across the upper half, leaving room for separate foliage and separate in-game Stars. Taller majestic silhouette, not a squat hedge or flat bridge. Asymmetrical organic details, structurally connected wood.
Materials: detailed weathered grey-brown oak bark, subtle olive moss near roots, soft neutral warm highlights. Cohesive restrained natural colours matching the reference game's high-detail pixel art.
Background: genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha, including the central opening and all gaps between branches. No painted checkerboard.
Constraints: trunk, roots and bare branches ONLY. NO leaves, NO stars or sparkles, NO fire or brazier, NO glowing magical effects, NO red/purple/magenta outlines, NO scenery, NO text, NO ground slab or shadow rectangle. All ornaments and gameplay entities will be composed separately by the game. Preserve fine clean natural edge detail without coloured fringes.

assets.name: foliage-living
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent modular leafy crown cluster sprite for a side-view 2D dark-fantasy pixel-art life tree.
Input image 1 is a material/style reference from the existing game; do not copy its cyan/purple colour or its fringe.
Primary request: a beautiful natural green oak foliage cluster, forming one organic spreading branch canopy. A few readable grey-brown internal limbs support layered bunches of small olive, forest-green and sage leaves with restrained golden-green highlights. Calm natural saturation, a clear rounded but asymmetrical silhouette and small airy gaps. It will be reused as five independently growing and dying regions of a larger tree, so produce ONE coherent unlabelled cluster, not an entire tree and not a sheet of variants.
Style: polished high-detail hand-painted pixel art, crisp readable clusters and soft controlled shading matching an old-school dark fantasy 2D game. Front/side orthographic view, no perspective floor.
Composition: centred branch canopy, wider than tall, isolated inside a square image with clean 8 percent margins. Broadest across its middle; taper organically near edges. No trunk extending out of frame.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, including all small gaps between leaves. No painted checkerboard.
Constraints: foliage and a few supporting twigs ONLY; no stars, crystals, fruit, lights, glow, particle specks, red/purple/magenta leaves or outlines, labels, text, ground, sky or scenery. The in-game coloured Stars are separate objects and must NOT be baked into this art.

assets.name: foliage-consumed
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one transparent consumed/dead branch canopy sprite for a modular dark-fantasy 2D pixel-art life tree.
Input image 1 is the matching living green foliage cluster. Change ONLY its vitality: the same cluster has lost ALL leaves and life after its Stars were consumed. Preserve the broad branch fan's location, orientation, general footprint and the reference pixel-art rendering style.
Primary request: a clearly dead, blackened and brittle branch fan, irregular forked limbs and snapped twig tips, entirely leafless. An understated cool charcoal/ashen bark palette, pale worn cut edges for legibility against a dark night background, a few desiccated moss fibres at most. Strong readable bare skeleton, no leafy silhouette. The loss should be dramatically obvious beside an adjacent green living cluster. Do not draw red veins or magical energy.
Composition: one isolated roughly oval fan of dead branches centred inside a square image, same relative image placement and margins as the reference. Side/front orthographic view. This will be laid over a larger trunk, not used as a whole tree or terrain piece.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, including all gaps between twigs. No painted checkerboard.
Constraints: no leaves, stars, crystals, lights, flame, dust cloud, coloured glow, pink/purple edge fringe, ground, scene, text or labels. Do not add UI or bake in any gameplay entity.
